attributes.board_name: District of Columbia Board of Medicine

rules.unit: AMA PRA Category I hours or Board-approved CE credits
rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category I or Board of Medicine approved CE; for the LGBTQ hours, Category I-equivalent prescribed by AAFP or another Board-approved entity
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for initial licensure or the first renewal of a license granted by examination.
rules.alternatives: Exemption on written request for hardship, disability, serious illness, service in Congress, military service, or postgraduate training (not for disciplinary suspension). Applies to physicians actively practicing in DC.

topics.who: At least 10% of the 50 hours in DC Health public health priorities (sexual/reproductive health, chronic disease, One Health, workforce retention incl. suicide prevention, substance use and implicit bias, community and patient safety)
Cultural competence or clinical treatment for LGBTQ individuals (AMA PRA Category I or equivalent)
All physicians (MD/DO): at least one course in the subject of pharmacology (hours not specified by the Board)

rules.notes: One board for MDs and DOs. Since June 16, 2024 licenses move to a birth-month cycle (expire last day of birth month, odd/even year by birth year); during the transition 50% of CE accepted for terms under 2 years, but LGBTQ and public health hours still apply.
rules.rule_quote: Physicians (MD/DO) - Fifty (50) hours of CE every two (2) years, which includes two (2) hours in the subject of LGBTQ cultural competency, five (5) hours in a topic designated as a public health priority, and at least one (1) course in the subject of pharmacology.
